title: An All-digital 8.6-nJ/Frame 65-nm Tsetlin Machine Image Classification Accelerator
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers (accepted, 2025)
new_feature: First manufactured ASIC for the convolutional Coalesced TM: an all-digital, inference-only 65 nm accelerator with 128 parallel clauses, all TA actions and 8-bit weights held in clock-stopped registers, a clause switching reduction feedback (CSRF) in the sequential-OR clause logic, and clock gating, reaching 8.6 nJ per MNIST classification.

datasets.booleanization: threshold: pixel > 75 -> 1 (U=1 bit/pixel); 10x10 conv window + 36 thermometer position bits = 136 features, 272 literals per patch

datasets.split_as_reported: not used experimentally; only for an envisaged scaled-up design estimate
datasets.booleanization: TM Composites specialists (e.g. histogram of gradients, thresholding) assumed
datasets.notes: Estimates only, no hardware/software run reported in this paper.

Code URL written with underscores as in the GitHub repo name (paper text shows spaces from line wrapping); [30] FPGA code at https://github.com/satunheim/ConvCoTM-FPGA-28x28.
